composition.serve_who: GMMS 108′-110a is the vessel’s 24 V DC service-supply one-line. Its main subject is the DC distribution system: four MAPS 600/24 V converter outputs and one 230 VAC/24 VDC reserve source are selected through isolators onto the +24 V service bus, with an auxiliary-service battery connection, shunt metering, negative return, and outgoing feeders. The left HVPDU bus sections serve the MAPS inputs; the right-hand named branches specifically serve the forward/aft DC panels, main bilge pump, fire pump, LV BAE panel, auxiliary-service battery, and generator-start battery.

infrastructure.system_name: High Voltage Power Distribution Unit — port and starboard 600 VDC input distribution
facts: The PORT and STBD 600 VDC bus bars are internal HVPDU buses, not a separate backbone system.
Each side shows Q1-Q4 at 32 A; only Q4 is drawn feeding that side’s MAPS-1/2 conversion block on this sheet.
Each HVPDU side has upstream F1/F2 500 A devices shown in the bus structure.
The PORT and STBD HVPDU sections remain distinct physical units although attached to the shared HVPDU node.

infrastructure.system_name: 24 V DC service distribution and source-selection infrastructure
facts: The +24 V SERVICE BUS accepts up to five drawn source channels: PORT MAPS channels through SW1/SO1 and SW2/SO2, STBD MAPS channels through SW3/SO3 and SW4/SO4, and the 230 VAC/24 VDC reserve converter through F18 125 A, CT5 and SW5/SO5.
Neutral/default topology is source isolators open; any deliberately closed source channel connects only along its drawn conductor to the common service bus.
The reserve source path is 230 VAC L/N → 24 VDC 110 A converter → F18 125 A → CT5 → SW5/SO5 → SHUNT #1 → +24 V SERVICE BUS → loads → NEGATIVE BUS → converter negative.
The +24 V SERVICE BUS feeds FWD DC PANEL via F5 100 A and SW6, and AFT DC PANEL via F6 200 A and SW7.

The NEGATIVE BUS is the common 24 VDC return for FWD DC PANEL, AFT DC PANEL, bilge pump, fire pump, generator-start battery, emergency battery and auxiliary-service battery; the adjacent 230 VAC ground annotation denotes ship’s ground bonding, not a 230 VAC rating for the negative bus.
SHUNT #1 is rated 500 A/50 mV and its sense leads continue through T/S S terminals 1/1/2/3 toward DWG 413 / BAE voltage sense.
Source-isolator control is routed through terminal strip T/S S terminals 4-12 and relays Re1/Re2; the exact command truth table is not established by this sheet alone.
The PC CARD contains BAE/AUX selection and indication interfaces; external connections include AUX, BAE, NEG and +EM conductors. Its individual five-channel lamp meanings are not printed.
Emergency control power is drawn from +24 V EMERGENCY POWER through QE7 6 A and exact fused terminal T/S E-8 into the control wiring.
The five service-bus feeder switches are SW6-SW10; pump and LV BAE branches additionally use SO6-SO8 contactors.
The sheet draws a PC CARD with two ten-pin interfaces, BAE/AUX selector contacts, and upper/lower five-channel indicator-lamp networks.
A conductor leaves the PC CARD toward “BEL-1/4 230V AC CONTROL” with cross-reference DWG 401a.
Only the drawn pin/interface wiring is established here; the off-sheet meanings of channels 1-5 and 10 are not printed.
